summary: Implemented the desktop-only admin request administration surface for all seven approved request screens. The feature uses the implemented request, overdue-request, viewing, and request-issue contracts, renders server-safe projections and available actions, supports optimistic-version transitions, assignment, notes, and issue resolution, and provides localized RTL/LTR state handling.
